title: DesignRequest
description: What a designer is given: the requirements, a stance and the practices its design is judged on; when it answers a challenge, its design and what the challenger found. Never another design.

file.description: The requirements file, relative to the project, as requirements.check named it.

requirements.description: The requirements file whole, as requirements.check accepted it.

stance.description: The constraint this designer works under, set by script.

practices.description: The practices held by design, from the practices files on the integration branch, each its id and its words.

design.description: The design the challenger judged, as schemas/design.json gives it.

id.description: The practice's id, such as P-35.

answer.description: Whether the design holds the practice.

sentence.description: Why, in one sentence; for not-held, where the design breaks it.

practices.description: The first challenge's answers of not-held, each with its sentence.

wrong.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

where.description: Where in the design: a module, an interface, an action or an example, by name.

fix.description: What would fix it, in one sentence.

answering.description: Only when the designer answers a challenge, once: the design it judged, each practice it answered not held and its findings.
